Method of Attack: Abuse of regsvr32.exe Windows command-line utility to load COM scriptlets from remote sources using DLLs (scrobj.dll) to drop malware such as Qbot and Lokibot
Registering OCX files to call ready-made components like DLLs
Using malicious Microsoft Office documents (Excel, Word, RTF, composite files) with macros that start regsvr32 as a child process
Phishing campaigns and blind SEO poisoning attacks to distribute malicious documents
Fileless malware execution from within documents via remote COM scriptlets
Bypassing application blocklisting by using a legitimate Windows tool
Impacted Systems: Microsoft Office documents (Excel, Word, RTF, composite document files)
Attack Vector: Malicious Microsoft Office documents with macros
Indicators of Compromise: Indicators of compromise list shared by Uptycs on GitHub repository
